title: Spyglass is Live: Unlock New Possibilities
summary: The highly anticipated Spyglass tool has officially launched, bringing powerful new insights and capabilities to all users.

title: Enhanced File Management
summary: Elevate your content creation experience with intuitive new controls for seamlessly managing and beautifully displaying all your embedded files and images directly within the editor.

title: Explore Our New Product Roadmap
summary: We're excited to launch our new public roadmap, offering full transparency into what we've shipped, what's coming next, and our future plans.

title: Effortless Checkboxes
summary: Enjoy a more productive experience with our revamped checkboxes, now bigger, easier to click, and effortlessly draggable for seamless task management.

title: Enhanced Collaborative Editing
summary: Experience seamless teamwork with enhanced real-time collaboration that brings more awareness and ease to working with others.

title: Seamless Discovery of Shared Content
summary: Effortlessly find and collaborate on all the valuable content shared with you by friends and colleagues, making teamwork more productive and connected.

title: Noeko: Now Open Source!
summary: We're thrilled to announce Noeko is now open source, offering our community full transparency and the opportunity to directly contribute to its evolution.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Experience Noeko in your native language as we roll out robust support for many international languages, connecting more users globally.

title: Discover a World of Beautiful Themes
summary: We're elevating your visual experience with a wider array of beautifully designed themes, allowing you to personalize Noeko to perfectly match your style.

title: Personalized Knowledge Exploration
summary: Unlock deeper insights within your knowledge base by leveraging powerful new filters and workflow integrations in the enhanced Constellation view.

title: Advanced Search & Custom Compendiums
summary: Effortlessly organize and retrieve your knowledge by applying advanced filters and saving personalized Compendiums for instant access to your most relevant information.

title: Dynamic Note Connections
summary: Experience a more intuitive and interactive way to connect and display your ideas, making your notes come alive with dynamic previews and effortless organization.

title: Noeko: Enhanced Control with Self-Hosted and Premium Plans
summary: Empower your workflow with the upcoming release of Noeko's self-hostable option and versatile premium plans, designed to give you ultimate control and access to advanced capabilities.

title: Smarter Time-Aware Greetings
summary: Enjoy an even more personalized welcome as we update our greetings to precisely reflect the time of day wherever you are.

title: Efficiently Manage Tagged Items
summary: Effortlessly remove multiple ideas, quests, or sources from a tag directly within the tag view, significantly streamlining your organization process.

title: Bring Your World of Information
summary: Seamlessly integrate content from across the web and your files, including YouTube videos and articles, to create a richer, more connected knowledge hub.
